name: xbert-review
description: Run month-end exception review with XBert AI agents.

x-xbert.tagline: One command to run a full exception review with audit workpapers.
x-xbert.longDescription:
Month-end close in a bookkeeping practice is a churn of unreconciled items, GST anomalies, and duplicate suppliers — work that swallows senior bookkeepers' days, gets passed to juniors who miss things, and ultimately exposes the practice to compliance risk.

XBert Month-End Review wraps the entire exception workflow into a single Claude command. It pulls live exceptions from your connected ledger, groups them by category and materiality, walks you through each item with source documents attached, and emits a markdown workpaper you can drop straight into the file.

useCases.title: Pre-report sweep
useCases.description: Run across a client's Xero, QBO, or MYOB file at month-end to catch what shouldn't make it into the report you're about to send.

useCases.title: Duplicate-supplier hunt
useCases.description: Surfaces same-supplier, same-amount, ±3-day invoices before they get paid twice.

useCases.title: BAS / GST prep
useCases.description: Triages mismatched tax codes and missing GST entries in bulk before the quarterly lodgement.

useCases.title: ATO audit trail
useCases.description: Generates signed-off markdown workpapers ready to drop into a review-defence file.

benefits.title: Cut close time
benefits.description: From three days of senior bookkeeper time to half a day — with a full audit trail at the end.

benefits.title: Catch what humans miss
benefits.description: AI surfaces patterns across the period — drift in cost coding, suspicious manual journals — that get lost in row-by-row review.

benefits.title: Never auto-applied
benefits.description: Every action is proposed, never applied. You stay in control. The workpaper records every approval and reason.

workflow: Confirm the entity and period (defaults to the current month and your primary entity)
Plugin pulls open exceptions from XBert and groups them by category and materiality
Walk through each item — approve, edit, or skip with a reason
A markdown workpaper drops onto your desk, ready for the file
